name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 35 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2025-11-28, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 3.72 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
